function.name: list_teams
function.description: List all teams in an organization following Microsoft Graph API v1.0. Supports OData query parameters: $filter, $select, $top, $skiptoken, and $count. Returns only id, displayName, and description by default (matching MS Graph API behavior). To get all properties for a specific team, use the get_team tool. API Endpoint: GET /teams

_count.description: Include count of total items in the response

_filter.description: OData filter expression to filter teams. Examples: "startswith(displayName, 'A')" - teams starting with A, "displayName eq 'My Team'" - exact match, "contains(displayName, 'Project')" - teams containing 'Project'

_select.description: Comma-separated list of properties to return. By default returns id, displayName, description. Examples: 'id,displayName', 'id,description,visibility'

_skiptoken.description: Pagination token for retrieving the next page of results

verifiers.name: call_quality_channel_created
verifiers.description: Verifies that the private channel 'Call Quality Review' was created in TechCorp Solutions Team

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM channels WHERE team_id = 'team_techcorp_001' AND display_name = 'Call Quality Review' AND membership_type = 'private';

verifiers.name: it_support_members_added
verifiers.description: Verifies that Bob Smith and Carol White were added as members to the private channel 'Call Quality Review'

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM channel_members WHERE channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE display_name = 'Call Quality Review' AND team_id = 'team_techcorp_001') AND user_id IN ('bob.smith', 'carol.white');

verifiers.name: analysis_report_posted
verifiers.description: Verifies that a call quality analysis report was posted to the private channel 'Call Quality Review'

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM channel_messages
                    WHERE channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels
                      WHERE display_name = 'Call Quality Review'
                      AND team_id = 'team_techcorp_001')
                    AND LOWER(body_json) LIKE '%duration%'
                    AND LOWER(body_json) LIKE '%participant%'
                    AND (LOWER(body_json) LIKE '%call quality%'
                      OR LOWER(body_json) LIKE '%audio%'
                      OR LOWER(body_json) LIKE '%dropped%')
                    AND LOWER(body_json) LIKE '%investigat%';

tools.reason: Pure collection read of call records; task requires investigating call data for Oct 23-31 2025, and the exposed _filter supports startDateTime range filtering. Observed shape has value array but no numeric count/total field, so partial_read is not supported. Eligible for truncated_read and reply_mixup (same route, different filter arguments).

Pure read of a single user by ID or UPN; needed to resolve Bob and Carol identities for channel membership. Single-object read, no collection count, so partial_read unsupported. Truncated_read and reply_mixup apply (same route, different user arguments).

Creates a new channel message (POST). Task requires posting the analysis report and team notification. Creation receipt loss is possible; no exposed message-lookup tool exists to discover the created message by content, and no documented idempotency behavior is supplied, so unknown_commit_create is unsupported. transient_unexecuted applies (write intercepted before execution, safe exact retry).

Pure read of a single call record by id; used to inspect details like participants and sessions for the incident window. Single-object read, no collection count, so partial_read unsupported. Truncated_read and reply_mixup apply (same route, different id arguments).

Pure collection read of users; needed to resolve Bob and Carol. Exposed _count parameter provides a numeric total, so partial_read is supported. Also eligible for truncated_read and reply_mixup (same route, different filter arguments).

Adds a member to a private/shared channel (POST). Task requires adding Bob and Carol to the new private channel. This is a membership creation; no exposed tool lists channel members to discover the added member, and no idempotency behavior is documented, so unknown_commit_create is unsupported. transient_unexecuted applies (write intercepted before execution, safe exact retry).

Pure collection read of channels in a team; needed to find the TechCorp Solutions Team and verify the new channel. Observed shape includes @odata.count, so partial_read is supported. Also eligible for truncated_read and reply_mixup (same route, different teamId/filter arguments).

Creates a new channel (POST). Task requires creating the private 'Call Quality Review' channel. Creation receipt loss is possible; recovery is via list_channels with the original teamId and displayName filter to discover the created channel, so unknown_commit_create is supported. transient_unexecuted also applies (write intercepted before execution, safe exact retry).

Pure collection read of team members; needed to resolve Bob and Carol identities. Observed shape includes @odata.count, so partial_read is supported. Also eligible for truncated_read and reply_mixup (same route, different teamId/filter arguments).

Pure collection read of sessions for a call record; needed to inspect session-level failure info for the incident window. Observed shape has value array but no numeric count/total field, so partial_read is not supported. Eligible for truncated_read and reply_mixup (same route, different id arguments).

Pure collection read of teams; needed to find the TechCorp Solutions Team workspace. Exposed _count parameter provides a numeric total, so partial_read is supported. Also eligible for truncated_read and reply_mixup (same route, different filter arguments).
